findings.description: Joseph Gioiello was born about 1898 in South America. Two independent U.S. federal census enumerations (1940 and 1950) both give this same birth year and birthplace.
supporting_sources: United States, Census, 1940 -- household of Joseph Gioiello, Niles, Weathersfield Township, Trumbull, Ohio (age consistent with birth about 1898, birthplace South America)
